Hill Dwarf.description: Possessing extra intuition and remarkable resilience, attuned to the earth.

features.name: Dwarven Toughness
features.tldr: Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 every time you gain a level.

Mountain Dwarf.description: Strong and hardy, accustomed to a difficult life in rugged mountain terrain.

features.name: Dwarven Armor Training
features.tldr: You gain proficiency with light and medium armor.
